fusions.name: Drowning Grip
fusions.desc: Holds the target under, dealing 22 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 1.4 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Sweeping Flipper
fusions.desc: Sweeps a broad flipper ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it and knocking them 2.5 tiles back. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cradling Fin
fusions.desc: Wraps a fin around you as a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and raises your armour by 5% for 6 seconds. Your movement speed rises 10% for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Never Lets Go
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, you gain a ward worth 25% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
